data.exact_reserve_text: The provision for claims at the beginning of the year and at the end of the year in respect of prior years' claims provision are as follows:
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1225 shows an opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2015) of GBP 441.7m. The syndicate reports a favourable prior years' claims movement in 2016 of GBP 27.8m (a release), representing approximately a 6.3% improvement versus the opening gross claims outstanding. The report attributes this movement to favourable prior years claims development.

data.data_quality_notes: Values were visually extracted from scanned pages. Opening gross claims outstanding (441.7) was read from the Balance Sheet prior-year column (page 9). The prior-year movement (-27.8) was taken from the 'Prior years' claims provision' note (page 20) but it is not fully clear from the scan whether the note figure is gross or net; it is assumed gross for this extraction. Gross premium total and mix were inferred from the segmental/statement pages (page 19) where the printed table is hard to read; the mix is provided as a single 'Reinsurance' line as a conservative placeholder. Where text was illegible or ambiguous the confidence scores have been reduced and the relevant fields noted.
